metadata.description:
My children love these brownies and you can't even tell they are made with black beans. 

Preheat oven 350 F or 180 C

Items you will need: 
- Mixing bowl
- Big spoon
- Spatula
- 1 Tablespoon
- 1 Teaspoon
- 1 1/4 Teaspoon
- Food processor or blender
- Dry measuring cup
- Liquid measuring cup
- Fork
- Strainer
- 8x11 inches baking dish
- Oven mitt
- Oven

Ingredients: 
- Cooked black beans
- Your choice of cooking oil
- Honey
- Salt
- Baking powder
- Vanilla
- Oatmeal 
- Coca powder
